name: manifest20
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
e=json.loads((p/'TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json').read_text())['excluded_exact_files']
a=json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert a['count']==30 and a['mismatches']==[]
rows=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if f.is_file() and str(f.relative_to(p)) not in e:
  data=f.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':str(f.relative_to(p)),'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
m={'algorithm':'SHA256','scope':'Every own-lane file present at terminal child manifest computation, including all frozen inputs/helpers, all source acquisition plans, ledgers, source payloads, images, reports, full local display outputs and all previously completed runner receipts','excluded_exact_files':e,'files':rows,'frozen_after':a,'completed_runner_receipts':[r['path'] for r in rows if r['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')]}
s=json.dumps(m,indent=2)
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(rows),'completed_runner_receipts':len(m['completed_runner_receipts']),'frozen_after':a,'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'exclusions':e}))
